interface.name: press_depth_v1

description.summary: put a window behind the others

interface.description:
Some desktops gave every window a box that sent it behind all the others, where it stayed in view wherever nothing covered it. The window protocol has a way to put a window away and none to put it behind, so a desktop that will do it offers this.
A program that draws its own title bar asks when the user presses such a box. A desktop is free to do nothing.

request.name: send_to_back

description.summary: put a window behind every other

request.description: Put the window whose surface this is behind every other window, and give the keyboard to the one then in front. The serial is that of the press of a button or a key that asked for it, to show that the user did.
